newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 6c to 575c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 6c to 575c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose by 6.0 cents to 575 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Melbourne on Thursday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices rose again, with the 19 micron indicator slightly dearer and 20/21/22/23/25m 1.0 percent dearer.
The 24m category was 2.0 percent dearer, while 26m was 0.5 percent dearer, WI said.
Merino skirtings prices also rose. The 19/20m indicators were 1.0 percent dearer, 21/22m were 2.0 percent dearer and 23m 2.5 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/28/29m were up to 1.0 percent dearer and 30/31m up to 1.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs and locks were unchanged while crutchings were 1.0 percent cheaper.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with good support from Taiwan and Western Europe.
Of 23,924 bales offered in both centres, 6.7 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with about 73,000 bales to be offered.
